description: A Flutter widget implementing a map-centric home screen with Google Maps integration, location handling, ride simulation, and UI overlays for a ride-hailing app.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main widget for the map-based home screen, managing state, map interactions, and ride flow.

classes.name: _HomeFragmentState
classes.description: State class for HomeFragment, handling location, map, markers, ride simulation, and UI updates.

methods.name: _getCurrentLocation
methods.description: Fetches current device location, updates map and address, and initializes markers.

methods.name: _reverseGeocode
methods.description: Converts latitude and longitude into a human-readable address.

methods.name: _initializeMarkers
methods.description: Sets up initial rider markers near the user's location.

methods.name: _buildGoogleMap
methods.description: Constructs the Google Map widget with error handling fallback.

methods.name: _buildMapFallback
methods.description: Displays a placeholder UI when Google Maps fails to load.

methods.name: _onCameraIdle
methods.description: Handles map camera idle event to update location and address.

methods.name: _buildBottomPanel
methods.description: Builds the bottom UI panel with location info, destination, and ride button.

methods.name: _buildRideStatusCard
methods.description: Displays current ride status during an active ride.

methods.name: _openLocationSearch
methods.description: Opens the location search bottom sheet.

methods.name: _onDestinationSelected
methods.description: Handles destination selection, updates markers, route polyline, and camera.

methods.name: _drawRoutePolyline
methods.description: Draws a curved red route polyline between origin and destination.

methods.name: _generateRoutePoints
methods.description: Creates intermediate points for a curved route line.

methods.name: _fitMapToRoute
methods.description: Adjusts camera to fit both user and destination markers.

methods.name: _showRideBottomSheet
methods.description: Displays the ride booking bottom sheet.

methods.name: _startRiderApproach
methods.description: Simulates rider approaching the user's location.

methods.name: _onRiderArrived
methods.description: Handles rider arrival, prompts to start journey.

methods.name: _startJourney
methods.description: Simulates the journey progress towards destination.

methods.name: _onJourneyComplete
methods.description: Completes ride, navigates to celebration screen, resets state.
